applicabilityBasis.summary: VNXAU represents allocated physical gold and is marketed as a commodity or investment token, not as a fiat-redeemable payment stablecoin.

references.label: FMA Liechtenstein notice on physical precious metals

genius.licensingRegulator: Liechtenstein Financial Market Authority (FMA); TVTG/Blockchain Act registrations

references.label: FMA Liechtenstein current register: VNX Commodities AG TVTG registrations

genius.notes: VNXAU represents one gram of allocated physical gold with holder ownership and physical redemption, not an obligation to redeem a fixed amount of national currency or currency-denominated monetary value. Market-price sale/exchange into cash does not itself create that obligation. GENIUS payment-stablecoin authorization and DASP payment-stablecoin offering restrictions are therefore not applicable. FMA TVTG registrations and its general physical-metals notice are not U.S. issuer authorization or a token-specific MiCA exemption.
